description: Free, read-only. Query a comma-separated CSV with a header row, from a URL (max 5 MB, streamed) or inline text, one of the two: select columns, filter rows, sort, limit. Returns {meta:{returned_rows,columns,total_rows,truncated},rows:[{column:value}]}, all values strings, or CSV text with format='csv'. One filter condition, no joins or aggregates. Unknown select columns and bad filters error with the valid names or operators. Over 5 MB: csv_query_xl (paid, 100 MB).

csv.description: Inline CSV text. Not with url.

filter.description: 'column op value'. Ops: = != contains startswith endswith (text, case-insensitive), > >= < <= (numeric). E.g. 'age >= 30'.

format.description: json (default): {meta,rows}. csv: text with header row.

limit.description: Rows to return. Default 500, max 5000; over it meta.truncated=true.

select.description: Columns to keep, comma-separated, exact header names. Omit for all.

sort_by.description: Column to sort by; numeric when values parse as numbers, else text.

url.description: CSV URL, max 5 MB. Not with csv.

name: csv_query
title: Query CSV
